{{CharInfobox| color={{water color}} | corecolor={{water color light}} | bordercolor={{water color dark}} | name=Captain Aidan | jname=ラッセル | tmname=Russell | slogan=no | image=Captain_Aiden.png | size=250px | caption=Aidan | gender=Male | hometown=[[Ascorbia Island]] | region=[[Orange Islands]]| trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=EP106 | epname=The Pokémon Water War | enva=[[Dan Green]]| java=Kazuo Hayashi| }} '''Captain Aidan''' (Japanese: '''ラッセル''' ''Russell'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a firefighter commander stationed on [[Ascorbia Island]], where he leads [[Team Wartortle]] in rescue efforts. ==History== Captain Aidan debuted in ''[[EP106|The Pokémon Water War]]''. He drove onto the scene of a warehouse fire and had [[Team Wartortle]] put it out. He noticed {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}' efforts to help out and invited them over to the fire station for some training. [[Ash's Squirtle]] quickly developed a rivalry with the leader of Team Wartortle, and went on to compete against them in a series of training exercises. {{TRT}} later stole Squirtle, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and Team Wartortle just as an apartment complex fire broke out. {{an|Misty}} left on foot to fight the fire while [[Tracey's Venonat]] led Captain Aidan and the others to Team Rocket's cabin hideout. Captain Aidan and Ash were able to recover the stolen Pokémon and send Team Rocket flying before rushing over to the apartment and putting the fire out. In ''[[EP147|The Fire-ing Squad!]]'', Captain Aidan traveled to [[Johto]] with Team Wartortle to compete in the [[Fire and Rescue Grand Prix]]. He and Team Wartortle were the defending champions, and Aidan also managed to convince the event management team to allow Ash to enter on short notice. he and his team made it all the way to the finals again, only to be defeated by [[Officer Jenny]] and the [[Squirtle Squad]], with help of the Squad's former leader, Ash's own Squirtle. ==Character== Captain Aidan enjoys his line of work since he gets to help people. He carries around a whistle to give [[Team Wartortle]] instructions during training and in live rescue situations. Captain Aidan is also competitive and his ambitious streak leads him to push his Pokémon to perform and improve their personal bests. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Captain Aidan's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Captain Aidan |pkmn=Squirtle |nick=Team Squirtle |type1=Water |img=Team Squirtle.png |epnum=EP106 |epname=The Pokémon Water War |desc=Captain Aidan's Team {{p|Squirtle}} is part of his firefighting squad and are used to tackle tight space rescues and fight small fires.
